CliniTrack posts each signed prescription here. 201 on first delivery, 200 on re-delivery.
Opens a refill dispense order (from the pharmacy, or from CliniTrack when the patient asks).
Manual trigger of the daily reminder run (admin / ops).

put.summary: CliniTrack keeps patient SMS contact and consent in sync here.

post.summary: Delivery-report webhook for the SMS gateway.
CliniTrack callback with billing references / outcomes.

ref.description: Caller's reference for the line (echoed on alerts).

hptCode.description: PPB HPT code: the drug's primary identifier.

reason.description: Why the change was made; stored on the version snapshot.

hptCode.description: For DRUG allergies, the drug's HPT code.

atcPrefix.description: For DRUG_CLASS allergies (or to widen a DRUG allergy), an ATC prefix such as J01C.

externalId.description: Set when the record originates in CliniTrack (upsert key).

ref.description: CliniTrack's line reference; alerts and overrides use it.

atcCode.description: Sent by CliniTrack for cross-checking against the drug master.

quantity.description: Quantity per fill, in the drug's unit of issue.

storeId.description: Pharmacy store that should fill it.

refillValidityDays.description: How long refills stay valid, in days from signing. Default 180.

overrides.description: Prescriber overrides for WARNING alerts, keyed by alert key.

storeId.description: Store to fill from; defaults to the original prescription's store.

overrides.description: Pharmacist overrides for WARNING alerts raised at verification.

substituteHptCode.description: HPT code of a generic substitute from the same substitution group.

witnessedBy.description: Second signatory for controlled drugs. Must differ from the dispenser.

priceListCode.description: Price list CliniTrack should bill against (e.g. SHA). Defaults to DEFAULT.
